sources.title: Crossfire FUZ-510 R-Fuzz - Effects Database
sources.excerpt: Effects Database has an exact record for the Crossfire FUZ-510 R-Fuzz and classifies the named model as a fuzz pedal in the Crossfire catalog. The page title explicitly identifies both the builder and the exact FUZ-510 R-Fuzz model, distinguishing it from other Crossfire effects.
